m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Finally! I thought I'd be standing here forever! Headmaster Ambrose said you'd come, but I had my doubts. How are things in Mirage?
Really? Grandfather Spider plans to turn back the Sands of Time? Wow! That's got to have something to do with the Eye of History.
Since you left, I've been helping Ambrose on this end, and it's been about a million times more fun. Now, we get to confront Duncan Grimwater.
To Triton Avenue then! That's where Duncan's hiding out. This'll be just like old times. You take the lead, and I've got your back.
Not before you brokered the deal with Malistaire and took the Eye of History! We're on to you, Duncan.
Hmm. Thank you, Duncan! Wizard, I think we got what we came for, didn't we? Ha! Let's go tell Ambrose!
Apparently, Duncan's not the Agent after all, but he gave us a clue: it's a "she" who lives on Firecat Alley. Any idea who it could be?
Aw, man! Not you again! When you beat me back at Malistaire's house, it pretty much ruined my chances of joining the Cabal...
Wait, you think I'm the Cabal's Agent? Pshah! I wish. I already told you - they've rejected me at every turn.
And I'm not saying who the real Agent is, either. If she found out, I'd never be able to walk down Firecat Alley again... aww! I didn't say that!
Well, isn't this a treat? Seeing the two of you together warms my heart. But tell me, what did you learn from Duncan Grimwater?
I am pleased to tell you that your friend Mellori has come a long way. She's become my go-to Wizard for all manner of errands.
Meantime, I have spent much time searching for information about the Cabal, but Malistaire's Journal remains our best lead.
You may recall the reference to the initials "G" and "D". I must believe this refers to Duncan Grimwater, since we know he's involved.
To that end, Mellori has tracked Duncan down. But I want you to help confront him, so when you can, please join Mellori in Olde Town.
Your name has become a mantra among the professors at Ravenwood. I expect Mellori will someday make a name for herself as well.
